question: Should QQBot intentionally reject and reconnect on inbound gateway frames over 16 MiB, matching the cited sibling gateway ceiling instead of retaining `ws`'s 100 MiB default?
rationale: The code and loopback proof establish the behavior, but selecting a fixed maximum for an external gateway is an operational compatibility and message-delivery policy decision that source inspection alone cannot make.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Merge the bounded policy, accepting that oversized QQBot events disconnect the gateway session rather than reaching application parsing.

options.title: Pause for QQ-specific evidence
options.body: Hold this PR until QQBot documentation, production-size telemetry, or owner guidance establishes that 16 MiB will not reject a supported event class.
